hw-r1.label: Kolkata Knight Riders' leading run-scorer
hw-r1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
hw-r1.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (6) GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY runs DESC

hw-w1.label: Kolkata Knight Riders' leading wicket-taker
hw-w1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
hw-w1.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (6) AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY wk DESC
